missions.title: First Crossing

reference_strategy_briefs.A: Bridge the bus crossing, divert water west, then skiff the dock group.
reference_strategy_briefs.B: Divert first, skiff the low dock, then build the bridge before the last surge.

missions.failure_explanation_brief: Leaving the dock above the flood threshold too long closes boarding; backup transport recovers the unrescued group.

missions.title: The Lower Road

reference_strategy_briefs.A: Put the generator on high ground and pump into the empty basin while the skiff cycles.
reference_strategy_briefs.B: Use paired barriers to spare the road, ferry the orchard first, and reserve the pump for the late surge.

missions.failure_explanation_brief: An outlet into the orchard transfers the hazard to waiting residents; debrief displays the actual flow path.

missions.title: Two Banks

reference_strategy_briefs.A: Bridge the high road for western pedestrians; use both boats on eastern and overflow groups.
reference_strategy_briefs.B: Evacuate east early with one skiff, route the other west, then bridge the final safe path.

missions.failure_explanation_brief: A boat assigned to a closing lane waits at a safe node; the player must reassign it.

missions.title: Power Before Water

reference_strategy_briefs.A: Protect the dry power spine and alternate pump assignments to lower both basins.
reference_strategy_briefs.B: Evacuate riverside first, then dedicate both pumps to the clinic/tram sector.

missions.failure_explanation_brief: Overcommitting power leaves a pump queued; the UI names the inactive consumer.

missions.title: The Long Way Home

reference_strategy_briefs.A: Build the long bridge route, protect generator ground, and ferry the isolated island.
reference_strategy_briefs.B: Prioritize island and orchard with the skiff, then redirect the late surge and open the land route.

missions.failure_explanation_brief: A poor early diversion consumes safe basin capacity and forces a longer evacuation; no instant unannounced loss.

missions.title: A Line in the Trees

reference_strategy_briefs.A: Break the nearest fuel strip and wet the approach.
reference_strategy_briefs.B: Defend the longer path and stage the campsite first.

missions.failure_explanation_brief: A gap in the firebreak permits predictable spread.

missions.title: Last Bus from Camp

reference_strategy_briefs.A: Stage one crawler on each loop and protect the common junction.
reference_strategy_briefs.B: Run both on the nearest camp first, then use the protected longer loop.

missions.failure_explanation_brief: An empty vehicle on the wrong loop costs time but can be rerouted.

missions.title: Water Is a Route

reference_strategy_briefs.A: Pump pond water into the tank and alternate sprinklers.
reference_strategy_briefs.B: Use firebreaks to minimize wetting and reserve pumped water for the return road.

missions.failure_explanation_brief: A sprinkler without water shows a visible dry gauge rather than pretending to operate.

missions.title: When the Wind Turns

reference_strategy_briefs.A: Protect both flanks selectively and time transport before the turn.
reference_strategy_briefs.B: Concentrate early rescues on the future downwind side, then retreat along the safe loop.

missions.failure_explanation_brief: Ignoring the visible wind timeline makes the formerly safe flank dangerous.

missions.title: The Green Corridor

reference_strategy_briefs.A: Clear a continuous corridor and wet only its vulnerable bends.
reference_strategy_briefs.B: Evacuate the farthest group first and progressively retreat the transport line.

missions.failure_explanation_brief: Protecting every decorative building leaves too little transport capacity.

missions.title: Hold the Station

reference_strategy_briefs.A: Brace the weak support and winch the upper group.
reference_strategy_briefs.B: Evacuate the upper group early, then stabilize for the remaining transfer.

missions.failure_explanation_brief: Bracing decorative rocks has no effect; only eligible supports accept placement.

missions.title: Above the Snowline

reference_strategy_briefs.A: Run both winches as a staged relay with separate power.
reference_strategy_briefs.B: Prioritize the observatory, then reuse the lower link for all groups.

missions.failure_explanation_brief: Moving people uphill into a temporary staging node without onward capacity blocks the route.

missions.title: The Quiet Slope

reference_strategy_briefs.A: Move the crawler through early and use the shelf afterward.
reference_strategy_briefs.B: Avoid the short road entirely and stage winch transfers above it.

missions.failure_explanation_brief: A closed road stops vehicles at a safe node; it does not fling rigidbody residents.

missions.title: Cable and Current

reference_strategy_briefs.A: Pump the basin before peak melt and brace the busiest cable.
reference_strategy_briefs.B: Evacuate the upper terrace before melt peaks, then shift power priority downward.

missions.failure_explanation_brief: Ignoring the lower basin breaks a logically correct upper rescue plan.

missions.title: Dawn at Frostline

reference_strategy_briefs.A: Use a vertical relay before the runout, then transfer onto the crawler.
reference_strategy_briefs.B: Clear the lower village first to free receiving capacity for the mountain groups.

missions.failure_explanation_brief: Using the receiving station as indefinite storage causes a capacity bottleneck.

missions.title: Between Two Tides

reference_strategy_briefs.A: Walk the nearest group early and ferry the late group.
reference_strategy_briefs.B: Use both boats from the beginning and reserve the bridge for the high route.

missions.failure_explanation_brief: An incorrect dock remains visible but rejects loading with a tide explanation.

missions.title: Keep the Light

reference_strategy_briefs.A: Build the longer elevated network immediately.
reference_strategy_briefs.B: Use the short network early, then transfer idle relays to the high sockets before peak tide.

missions.failure_explanation_brief: Moving a relay while its only route is actively required temporarily blocks unloading.

missions.title: The Floating Market

reference_strategy_briefs.A: Stagger arrivals through the two receiving docks.
reference_strategy_briefs.B: Evacuate one island fully, then reuse its high dock as a transfer point.

missions.failure_explanation_brief: Assigning all boats to one dock creates a readable queue, not overlapping models.

missions.title: Storm Switch

reference_strategy_briefs.A: Store inflow behind a barrier, then pump during low tide.
reference_strategy_briefs.B: Keep high docks available and prioritize boat evacuation while managing only the critical basin.

missions.failure_explanation_brief: A pump outlet submerged under a tide has reduced effect, clearly shown in its forecast.

missions.title: Harbor of Everyone

reference_strategy_briefs.A: Prioritize low docks, then use the outer loop for the final groups.
reference_strategy_briefs.B: Open the high causeway and use boats only for isolated islands while protecting the network.

missions.failure_explanation_brief: Saving the lighthouse alone cannot satisfy the rescue goal.

missions.title: A Path Through Heat

reference_strategy_briefs.A: Cool a crossing only when residents are ready to move.
reference_strategy_briefs.B: Stage residents in shelter, cool the longer route, then cross together.

missions.failure_explanation_brief: Cooling too early wastes the safe window; the timer remains visible.

missions.title: Borrowed Safety

reference_strategy_briefs.A: Stage one group, evacuate the other, then return along the cooled route.
reference_strategy_briefs.B: Use both shelters briefly and alternate transport pickups before heat peaks.

missions.failure_explanation_brief: Leaving residents in shelters fails the evacuation condition even if they remain safe.

missions.title: The Cooling Works

reference_strategy_briefs.A: Secure drainage and power first, then cool the short route.
reference_strategy_briefs.B: Evacuate via the longer path and save cooling for the late channel.

missions.failure_explanation_brief: Power loss stops production but does not erase stored coolant.

missions.title: Three Ways Out

reference_strategy_briefs.A: Ferry the coast early, then use crawler and cooling inland.
reference_strategy_briefs.B: Use shelter to stage inland groups while boats clear the receiving dock.

missions.failure_explanation_brief: Overloading one final landing creates a queue; capacity indicators must predict it.

missions.title: Every Little Life

reference_strategy_briefs.A: Stabilize the power/drainage spine, ferry coast groups, and cool the inland route just in time.
reference_strategy_briefs.B: Evacuate the most exposed groups first, use shelter for the high village, and dedicate late resources to the ferry connection.

missions.failure_explanation_brief: A plan that protects scenery but delays evacuation cannot earn a successful outcome.
